issues.text: The feature directory 'flavor-of-day' has no index.ts entry point, so there is no file re-exporting the feature's entire public API — nothing outside the feature can import it, and the Structure rules (exactly one index.ts, types in a dedicated <feature>-types.ts file, verb-first kebab-case logic files) are unmet. The directory must add an index.ts that re-exports the public API (e.g. export { run } from ... / export * from '<feature>-types'), and the 'old-rotation.ts' file is unreachable without it.

result.reason: The flavor-of-day feature directory contains flavor.ts and old-rotation.ts but lacks the required index.ts entry point that re-exports the entire public API. It also lacks the dedicated <feature>-types.ts file and verb-first kebab-case logic file names. The missing entry point directly violates the sole ratified axiom, and the other structural requirements cannot be satisfied as the directory stands.

issues.text: Missing required entry point index.ts file that re-exports the feature's entire public API. The feature directory contains flavor.ts and old-rotation.ts but no index.ts file to serve as the entry point.
Missing required <feature>-types.ts file (should be flavor-of-day-types.ts) as specified in the Structure section.

The logic files do not follow service conventions: they don't export a single 'run' function, don't use the Result<T> type pattern for error handling, and don't provide consumer-grade error messages as required by the Structure section.

The old-rotation.ts file appears to be legacy/dead code ('Kept around in case we go back to the old rotation') which may violate the 'One capability per feature' cohesion principle if it's truly unrelated functionality.
